title: Zesty Velvety Saudi Arabian Date Pudding
description: A tangy and velvety dessert featuring dates and a lacquer glaze, made with shortening for a light and airy texture. This macrobiotic-friendly dessert is perfect for warm evenings.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a blender, puree the dates, shortening, lacquer glaze, almond milk, honey, rose water, cardamom powder, and salt until smooth.
Place the ramekins in a large baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the edges are set and the centers are still slightly jiggly.
Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Serve chilled, garnished with a sprinkle of cardamom powder if desired.
